source: [D] #145 signer column. The existing RuleSet schema: spec is the node's control verdict, engine is the node's SDK verdict, column is the signing method, native holds measured scriptCode/digest predicates. Control refusals are not signer disagreements. Counts include only actual node judgments.

sighash.scriptcode.in-unlock.lock-only.decided_by: [SRC] bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 6504a3af src/script/interpreter.cpp:1471-1506 forms the unlock tail plus locking script after Chronicle, and refuses an incorrect signature. Before Chronicle it uses the unlock tail alone. [SRC] go-sdk v1.7.2 2ca481c5 transaction/template/p2pkh/p2pkh.go:83-91 calls CalcInputSignatureHash; transaction/signaturehash.go:277-299 reads SourceTxScript for BIP143, and :363-375 reads it for the original digest; transaction/input.go:43-59 resolves it to the source output's LockingScript; transaction/signaturehash.go:359-360 returns the original SINGLE sentinel; :108-116 preserves it without hashing.
sighash.scriptcode.in-unlock.lock-only.note: The default signing path uses the lock alone for a CHECKSIG in the unlock. The explicit scriptCode API signs the corpus scriptCode. Template paths are eligible only when the SDK actually exposes one; these pins expose no in-unlock template.

corpus.control.sigpushonly.decided_by: [SRC] bitcoin-sv v1.2.3 6504a3af src/script/interpreter.cpp:2321-2334 supplies this encoding or push-only refusal. [SRC] go-sdk v1.7.2 2ca481c5 transaction/template/p2pkh/p2pkh.go:83-91 calls CalcInputSignatureHash; transaction/signaturehash.go:277-299 reads SourceTxScript for BIP143, and :363-375 reads it for the original digest; transaction/input.go:43-59 resolves it to the source output's LockingScript; transaction/signaturehash.go:359-360 returns the original SINGLE sentinel; :108-116 preserves it without hashing.
corpus.control.sigpushonly.note: The corpus deliberately places a non-push unlock under a word/version requiring push-only. Both the SDK and hand-signed control must have this exact reject token. This is counted apart from signer divergences.
